description: Score N-terminal targeting features of all glycolytic pay-off phase enzymes in ST1 Nand II, testing the branched-glycolysis model of PMID 38780415 and re-evaluating the earlier negative control
code:
import requests, math, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

EIS=dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,
         L=1.06,K=-1.50,M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)
def hmoment(seq, delta=100.0):
    ang=np.deg2rad(delta)*np.arange(len(seq)); h=np.array([EIS.get(c,0.0) for c in seq])
    return math.hypot((h*np.cos(ang)).sum(),(h*np.sin(ang)).sum())/len(seq)
def feats(s,N=30,win=18):
    nt=s[:N]; pos=sum(nt.count(c) for c in "RK"); neg=sum(nt.count(c) for c in "DE")
    best=max((hmoment(nt[i:i+win]) for i in range(0,max(1,len(nt)-win+1))),default=0.0)
    return pos-neg, neg, best, nt

BASE="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
PAYOFF={"glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase":"GAPDH",
        "phosphoglycerate kinase":"PGK",
        "phosphoglycerate mutase":"PGAM",
        "enolase":"ENO",
        "pyruvate kinase":"PK"}
rows=[]
for q,short in PAYOFF.items():
    r=requests.get(BASE,params={"query":f'(proteome:UP000078348) AND (protein_name:"{q}")',
                                "fields":"accession,protein_name,length,sequence","format":"json","size":"50"},timeout=120)
    for e in r.json().get("results",[]):
        seq=e["sequence"]["value"]; L=e["sequence"]["length"]
        if L<200: continue            # drop fragments
        nc,ac,hm,nt=feats(seq)
        rows.append(dict(enzyme=short,acc=e["primaryAccession"],length=L,
                         net_charge_1_30=nc,acidic_1_30=ac,max_hyd_moment=round(hm,3),nterm=nt))
pay=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(["enzyme","max_hyd_moment"],ascending=[True,False])
pay.to_csv("glycolytic_payoff_nterminal.csv",index=False)
print(pay.to_string(index=False))

# Prior reference sets (computed in the earlier iteration, re-stated here for the comparison)
POS={"B3FHT4 SCS alpha":(4,1,0.488),"A0A196SEK7 SDH Fp":(5,0,0.603),"A0A196S3L2 hydrogenase":(4,1,0.448),
     "A0A196SCN8 SCS beta":(4,0,0.418),"A0A196SBG0 MDH":(5,0,0.488),"A0A196S9Q0 NDUFV1":(4,1,0.291)}
TEST={"A0A196SNA7 ASCT cand":(5,1,0.408),"A0A196SMF3 ASCT cand":(3,2,0.408),
      "A0A196SMQ0 ACD1":(4,1,0.406),"A0A196S6S6 ACD2":(4,1,0.427),"A0A196S9Z5 ACD3":(3,2,0.300)}
print("\nPositive-control median net charge",np.median([v[0] for v in POS.values()]),
      " moment",np.median([v[2] for v in POS.values()]))
print("Pay-off-phase enzymes with net charge >= +3 and 0-1 acidic residues in 1-30:",
      int(((pay.net_charge_1_30>=3)&(pay.acidic_1_30<=1)).sum()),"of",len(pay))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5,5.2))
ax.scatter([v[0] for v in POS.values()],[v[2] for v in POS.values()],s=90,c="#2a7fbf",
           marker="o",label="organelle-localised controls",edgecolor="k",lw=.5,zorder=3)
ax.scatter([v[0] for v in TEST.values()],[v[2] for v in TEST.values()],s=90,c="#e8a33d",
           marker="s",label="ASCT and ACD candidates",edgecolor="k",lw=.5,zorder=3)
cols={"GAPDH":"#4c956c","PGK":"#d1495b","PGAM":"#7b4fa3","ENO":"#8c6d31","PK":"#2f4858"}
for enz,sub in pay.groupby("enzyme"):
    ax.scatter(sub.net_charge_1_30+np.random.default_rng(1).normal(0,.07,len(sub)),sub.max_hyd_moment,
               s=70,marker="^",c=cols[enz],label=f"glycolytic pay-off: {enz} (n={len(sub)})",
               edgecolor="k",lw=.4,zorder=3)
ax.axvline(2.5,color="0.6",ls="--",lw=1); ax.axhline(0.40,color="0.6",ls="--",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("net charge of residues 1-30 (Arg+Lys minus Asp+Glu)")
ax.set_ylabel("maximum Eisenberg hydrophobic moment, 18-residue helix")
ax.set_title("Blastocystis ST1 Nand II N-terminal features\nGlycolytic pay-off enzymes score like organellar proteins, matching PMID 38780415",fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5,frameon=False,loc="lower left",ncol=2)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
